import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.lmplot(x='megapixels', y='price_usd', data=df, hue='sensor_type', 
           height=8, aspect=1.5, ci=None, legend_out=False, 
           scatter_kws={'alpha': 0.6})
plt.xlabel('Megapixels')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)')
plt.title('Camera Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type')
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
